name: com.cmdrvl/receipts
title: CMD+RVL Receipts: Free CMBS MCP Server
description: Free CMBS MCP server: verify claims against public CMBS filings and NPORT-P coupons, with citations.

tools.name: quickstart
tools.description: Compact capability manifest for clients: purpose, workflow, routing table, examples, vocabulary guard, scope caveats, next actions, and contact. A short, low-token summary of what this server does and what it returns.

detail.description: Default summary. Use routing for tool selection guidance, examples for more call examples.

tools.name: coverage
tools.description: What this server covers: deals and loans against the universe, the field inventory with full bound definitions, counterparty roles, current-only scope, and dual-sourced agreement stats (single-source reported separately). An OUT_OF_COVERAGE answer means the deal or field is outside this coverage; UNVERIFIED means it is covered but could not be confirmed. Contact cairn@cmdrvl.com for deeper coverage, history, bonds, entitlements.

tools.name: find_deals
tools.description: Search covered deals by id, trust name, CIK, alias, shelf, vintage or deal_ref. An EXACT query returns one dominant result. A fuzzy query returns a small ranked set with match reasons, periods and a suggested next call. Returns at most the requested number of matches.

query.description: Deal name, ticker-style id, CIK, alias, shelf/vintage fragment, or deal_ref to search.

limit.description: Maximum ranked candidates to return (default 5; 10 on the builtin fallback; max 25).

tools.name: covered_deals
tools.description: List every deal this server can verify, with CIKs, aliases and filing periods. Returns the full covered set, which can be long.

tools.name: verify_loan_field
tools.description: Verify one loan-grain field of a CMBS loan against the SEC 10-D and ABS-EE filings. Values are TRUST-LEVEL (this trust's piece, not the whole loan). Always the CURRENT period; the receipt stamps its as-of. Pass claimed_value: you get CONFIRM / DENY / CONFLICT / UNVERIFIED plus an sf-receipt. No claim: UNVERIFIED. An unknown deal, loan or field: OUT_OF_COVERAGE.

deal.description: Deal name or alias, e.g. 'WFCM 2020-C58' or 'Wells Fargo 2020-C58'.

loan_id.description: Loan / entity id within the deal, e.g. '25'.

field.description:
The loan-grain field to verify. One of (full definitions: coverage, or the receipt's field_definition):
• beginning_balance — trust-level SCHEDULED balance at period start
• ending_balance — trust-level SCHEDULED balance at period end (not the actual/as-paid balance)
• scheduled_principal — principal applied: scheduled amortization plus unscheduled (curtailments, payoffs)
• scheduled_interest — scheduled interest, trust-level
• note_rate — current note rate in percent (not origination rate, not pool WAC)
• servicer_advances — Taxes & Insurance (escrow) advances outstanding, not P&I advances
• paid_through_date — paid-through date (a date; exact match)

claimed_value.description: Claim to receipt (number, or date string for paid_through_date). Required: no claim = refusal, no value.

tools.name: verify_deal_field
tools.description: Verify one pool-level field of a deal: the ABS-EE loan-tape rollup against the 10-D trustee's reported fact. These are COLLATERAL (loan-pool) balances and flows, NOT bond or certificate balances, and SCHEDULED and ACTUAL are different fields. No loan_id. Always the CURRENT period. Pass claimed_value; no claim: UNVERIFIED; an unknown deal or field: OUT_OF_COVERAGE.

field.description:
The deal-grain (pool) field to verify. One of (full definitions: coverage, or the receipt's field_definition):
• beginning_scheduled_collateral_balance — pool SCHEDULED collateral balance at period start (not bond balance)
• ending_scheduled_collateral_balance — pool SCHEDULED collateral balance at period end (not bond balance)
• ending_actual_collateral_balance — pool ACTUAL (as-paid) collateral balance at period end
• total_principal_collected — pool principal collected: scheduled plus unscheduled

claimed_value.description: Claim to receipt. Required: no claim = refusal, no value.

tools.name: verify_fund_holding_coupon
tools.description: Verify the NPORT cross-filer annualized coupon rate (annualized_rate) for one security identifier. Security-grain, N-source receipt: citations are peer NPORT-P filings by registrant CIK, dissenters included. CURRENT-ONLY (latest NPORT period exported). Ticker matches are not unique: set require_hard_identifier=true when a claim needs ISIN, CUSIP or other hard identity.

identifier.description: Security identifier to look up: ISIN, CUSIP, other identifier, or ticker.

security_id_source.description: Optional source filter. Default any. Use ticker only for ticker-sourced matches.

require_hard_identifier.description: When true, exclude ticker-sourced matches because tickers are not unique hard identifiers.

as_of.description: Optional NPORT period guard (YYYY-MM). The public corpus is latest-period-per-security, not historical.

claimed_value.description: Claim to receipt. Required: no claim = refusal, no value.

tools.name: verify_building_size
tools.description: Verify issuance building size (Annex A vs ABS-EE); a unit mismatch is UNITS_INCOMMENSURATE, not DENY.

loan_id.description: Loan / entity id within the deal, e.g. '25'.

claimed_unit.description: Optional unit, e.g. square_feet or units.

tools.name: verify_appraised_value
tools.description: Verify issuance appraised value (Annex A vs ABS-EE); a date or basis mismatch is DATE_INCOMMENSURATE / BASIS_INCOMMENSURATE, not DENY.

loan_id.description: Loan / entity id within the deal, e.g. '25'.

tools.name: verify_counterparty
tools.description: Adjudicate 'who is the <role> on deal X' against the SEC 10-D counterparty roster (today: master and special servicer). A SINGLE-SOURCE roster fact. Master is the roster party, NOT the ABS-EE tape's primary servicer. Pass claimed_name: CONFIRM/DENY under the ledger's name normalization, never fuzzy. Says WHO the party is, not that a loan is in special servicing. Unknown deal or role: OUT_OF_COVERAGE.

role.description: Default special_servicer. Full definitions ride each receipt's field_definition.

tools.name: verify_loan_status_counts
tools.description: Verify count claims over loan status ('N in special servicing / paid off / defeased') for a deal. Counts are DERIVED from the ABS-EE tape, not reported by any filing. Three grains, never mixed: activity (active, resolved_paid_off, defeased); servicing: in_special_servicing = loans CURRENTLY with the special servicer (the count for 'N in special servicing'; it OVERLAPS active, never sum); resolution reason (resolved_via_special_servicing and other payoff reasons) = loans that already LEFT the pool, NOT current counts. Pass `claimed` for exact per-status adjudication. Uncovered deal: UNVERIFIED.

claimed.description: Optional claimed per-status counts, e.g. {"in_special_servicing": 10, "defeased": 2}. Each is adjudicated by EXACT match against the derived count.

tools.name: verify_claims
tools.description: Bulk verifier: paste text, get per-claim statuses. ASSERTIONS ONLY: a QUESTION ('is it $9.4M?') binds nothing and returns total 0; single-value questions are not claims and are not checked here. Deterministic grammar, four families: loan fields, pool fields, servicer identity, loan-status counts. Unparsed text is listed in unchecked_spans, never dropped. EXACT deal references (id, alias, CIK) work best; matching is never fuzzy. Statuses (verified / contradicted / insufficient_evidence / out_of_scope) are answers, not errors. Each claim has a claim_id, citations and a confidence.

text.description: The paragraph / memo excerpt to check.

deal_hint.description: Fallback deal context when a sentence names no deal (exact resolution only).

period_hint.description: YYYY-MM annotation only — latest-only server; a mismatch is noted and drops confidence one tier.

risk_tolerance.description: Default normal = max(ledger tolerance, stated precision); strict = ledger only; lenient = 2x stated precision. Counts and names are always exact.
